title: Gas report - Week 44
summary:
LNG
The LNG market strengthened this week, with increased fixing activity helping to reduce some of the available tonnage in both basins. The Atlantic market firmed following a number of fixtures and a slight drawdown in the position list, although further cargo requirements will be needed to maintain the momentum. On the BLNG1 Australia-Japan route, rates increased by $6,500 week-on-week to settle at $44,800/day.

children.title: LPG
children.summary: The LPG market remained relatively subdued this week. The East-West arbitrage remains open and continues to support cargo economics, while vessel availability remains broadly balanced against demand.
